title: Can Rabbits Eat Grapes?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Grapes?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage.
- Images are reused as placeholders and can be changed later.
-->

<section class="rcg-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-grapes">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcg-page,
    .rcg-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcg-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcg-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rcg-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcg-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcg-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcg-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcg-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rcg-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcg-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcg-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rcg-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcg-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcg-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcg-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcg-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcg-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcg-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcgFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 760px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay .rcg-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcg-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcg-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcg-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rcg-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcg-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcg-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcg-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcg-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcg-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcg-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rcg-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcg-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcg-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcg-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcg-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcg-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcg-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rcg-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcg-section h2,
    .rcg-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcg-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcg-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcg-content {
      display: grid;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .rcg-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcg-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcg-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rcg-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcg-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcg-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcg-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rcg-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcg-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcg-food-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcg-food-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 250px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcg-food-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcg-food-icon {
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.13);
      font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .rcg-food-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.32rem;
    }

    .rcg-food-card p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcg-mini-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-mini-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      color: #4b453c;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .rcg-mini-list li::before {
      content: "•";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcg-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcg-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .rcg-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }
.rcg-image-card img.rcg-white-bg {
  background: #ffffff;
}

    .rcg-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rcg-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcg-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
    }

    .rcg-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcg-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcg-warning-card h2 {
      color: var(--rc-danger);
    }

    .rcg-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcg-avoid-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-avoid-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcg-avoid-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcg-steps-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcg-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcg-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcg-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcg-step h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.22rem;
    }

    .rcg-step p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcg-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcg-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcg-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcg-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcg-side-card a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: #fff4d8;
    }

    .rcg-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcg-note strong {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
    }

    .rcg-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcg-related,
    .rcg-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header .rcg-pill {
      color: #4e6b45 !important;
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rcg-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcg-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rcg-related-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      background: #fff;
    }

    .rcg-related-card img {
      width: 92px;
      height: 92px;
      max-width: 92px;
      max-height: 92px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: #f1eadf;
    }

    .rcg-related-card h3 {
      margin: 4px 0 6px;
      color: #243320 !important;
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcg-related-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #332d26 !important;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
      font-weight: 650;

            <h3>Cut into pieces</h3>
            <p>
              Slice grapes into small pieces, especially for small rabbits or rabbits trying grapes for the first time.
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Feed a tiny amount</h3>
            <p>
              Offer a small portion and watch your rabbit afterwards for any signs of digestive upset.
            </p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcg-warning rcg-reveal" id="risks" aria-label="Risks of feeding grapes to rabbits">
      <div class="rcg-wrap rcg-warning-card">
        <div>
          <span class="rcg-pill">Important risks</span>
          <h2>Risks of feeding grapes to rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            Grapes are not poisonous to rabbits in small amounts, but they are sugary. Feeding too much fruit can cause problems, especially for sensitive rabbits.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rcg-avoid-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Too much sugar</strong>
            Grapes are naturally sweet. Too much sugar can upset your rabbit’s digestion and encourage unhealthy weight gain.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Soft poo or stomach upset</strong>
            If your rabbit develops soft droppings after eating grapes, stop feeding them and return to hay, water and normal safe foods.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Raisins and grape products</strong>
            Avoid raisins, grape juice, jam, dried fruit mixes and sugary grape-flavoured foods. These are too concentrated or processed for rabbits.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Picky eating</strong>
            Too many sweet treats can make rabbits less interested in hay, which is the most important part of their diet.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcg-section rcg-reveal" id="alternatives">
      <div class="rcg-narrow">
        <div class="rcg-panel">
          <span class="rcg-pill">Healthier choices</span>
          <h2>Better alternatives to grapes</h2>
          <p>
            Grapes are fine as a rare treat, but rabbits benefit more from leafy greens, herbs and plenty of hay. If you want to offer variety, choose foods that support a healthy rabbit diet.
          </p>

          <ul class="rcg-list">
            <li>Fresh hay should make up the main part of your rabbit’s diet.</li>
            <li>Safe leafy greens are better everyday choices than fruit.</li>
            <li>Fresh herbs such as parsley or mint can be a tasty option for many rabbits.</li>
            <li>Small pieces of apple or strawberry can also be occasional treats.</li>
            <li>Introduce any new food slowly and one at a time.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rcg-faq rcg-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Rabbit grape FAQs">
      <div class="rcg-narrow">
        <div class="rcg-section-header">
          <span class="rcg-pill">Frequently asked questions</span>
          <h2>Grape FAQs</h2>
          <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding grapes to rabbits.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcg-faq-list">
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat grapes safely?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat grapes in very small amounts as an occasional treat. Grapes are sweet and watery, so they should not be a daily food or a replacement for hay.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>How much grape can a rabbit eat?</summary>
            <p>Most rabbits only need a tiny piece of grape. For medium or larger rabbits, half to one small grape is usually enough, and smaller rabbits should have less.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>How often can rabbits eat grapes?</summary>
            <p>Grapes should only be offered occasionally, such as once or twice per week at most. They should not be fed every day because they are high in natural sugar.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat grape skin?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat grape skin if the grape is washed thoroughly first. Cut grapes into small pieces before feeding, especially for smaller rabbits.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat raisins?</summary>
            <p>Raisins are dried grapes and are much more concentrated in sugar, so they are best avoided. Fresh grapes in tiny pieces are a safer choice if you want to offer grape at all.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can baby rabbits eat grapes?</summary>
            <p>Baby rabbits should not be given sugary fruit treats. Their diet should stay simple and stable, and new foods should only be introduced carefully when they are old enough.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcg-final rcg-reveal">
      <div class="rcg-wrap rcg-final-box">
        <span class="rcg-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Rabbits can eat grapes, but only in tiny amounts</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat grapes as an occasional treat, but they should not be part of the daily diet. Grapes are high in natural sugar, so it is best to feed only a very small piece and only now and again.
        </p>
        <p>
          Always wash grapes, cut them into small pieces and watch your rabbit afterwards. If your rabbit gets soft poo, seems uncomfortable or has a sensitive stomach, avoid grapes and choose safer everyday foods instead.
        </p>
